entity.name: SciTeX Inc.
entity.description: SciTeX Inc. develops and stewards SciTeX, an AGPL-3.0 open-source scientific research infrastructure for reproducible, transparent, and AI-assisted research. SciTeX integrates literature discovery, data analysis, visualization, manuscript preparation, provenance tracking, and research automation while remaining self-hostable and vendor-neutral.

projects.name: SciTeX
projects.description: SciTeX is an open-source scientific research infrastructure spanning a modular ecosystem of research software. It provides tools for literature discovery, data analysis, statistics, visualization, manuscript preparation, research automation, and cryptographic provenance through Clew. Funding supports long-term maintenance, documentation, testing, interoperability, contributor support, infrastructure, and sustainable development of the SciTeX ecosystem.

channels.description: For grants, institutional sponsorships, or direct support, please contact SciTeX Inc. Payment details can be provided privately.

plans.name: SciTeX OSS development and sustainability
plans.description: Annual support for maintenance and development of the SciTeX open-source ecosystem, including documentation, testing, interoperability, contributor support, infrastructure, and long-term sustainability.
